guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「輪胎複合材料解離、鋼絲纖維分離與膠粉品管」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow tire-composite liberation, steel/fiber separation and rubber quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「複合材質清冊」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 650 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以固定通用比例結算不同批次可能錯估產率。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「粗碎切割與能耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 kWh/tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「刀具鈍化可增加耗能而未提高解離。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「解離程度與金屬回收」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量磁性出口總重會把附膠當鋼材回收。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「循環負荷與再磨」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 666.667 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以新料量選設備會忽略再磨造成的額外負荷。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「環境溫度與低溫破碎比較」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 12000 kJ，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較磨機用電會漏算冷卻製備成本。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「纖維風選與終端速度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.00756944 m/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把纖維當成同直徑球會錯估阻力和分選邊界。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「產品粒徑級配」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均尺寸相同的兩批仍可能有完全不同的細粉量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「殘留鋼絲與纖維品管」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只檢查表面會漏掉料堆內分層的鋼絲。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「除塵質量收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.04 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報濾材效率會隱藏罩口漏捕。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「用途驗證與全線收率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction of rubber input，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把副產鋼加到膠粉收率分子會混淆產品基準。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for composite-material inventory, first reproduce 650 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A universal fixed composition can misstate yield across batches." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for primary cutting and energy, first reproduce 30 kWh/tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Dull cutters can increase energy without better liberation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for liberation and metal recovery, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total magnetic-product mass counts attached rubber as recovered steel." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for circulating load and regrinding, first reproduce 666.667 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sizing equipment from fresh feed ignores recirculating load." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for ambient and cryogenic grinding comparison, first reproduce 12000 kJ, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mill electricity alone excludes cooling-supply costs." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for fiber air classification and terminal velocity, first reproduce 0.00756944 m/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating fiber as an equal-diameter sphere misestimates drag and separation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for product size distribution, first reproduce 0.8 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Two batches with equal mean size may have very different fines." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for residual steel and fiber quality control, first reproduce 200 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Surface inspection misses steel segregated within the pile." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for dust-capture mass balance, first reproduce 0.04 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Filter efficiency alone hides hood-capture losses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for application validation and whole-line yield, first reproduce 0.8 fraction of rubber input, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adding steel coproduct to rubber yield mixes product bases." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 比較乘用胎與重型胎樣本的材質收支。
在相同進料量比較新舊刀具的電流與粒徑。
量測鋼材出口的附膠與膠料出口的殘鋼。
增加篩上返回比例並比較磨機實際負荷。
比較不同初溫下最低冷卻需求與最終粒形。
對照同質量球粒與纖維的沉降觀察。
繪出累積通過曲線並單列兩端質量。
比較磁選前後及不同料堆位置的殘鋼。
另列罩口逃逸量後重算總外逸。
比較回收膠收率、總物料利用率及用途試驗三份證據。
evidenceEn: Compare material balances for passenger and heavy-duty tire samples.
Compare current and size distributions for new and worn cutters at equal feed.
Measure attached rubber in steel and residual steel in rubber.
Increase oversize return and compare actual mill loading.
Compare minimum cooling duty and particle shape at different initial temperatures.
Compare settling observations for equal-mass spheres and fibers.
Plot cumulative passing and report both tail masses.
Compare residual steel before/after magnets and across pile positions.
Add hood bypass to recalculate total escape.
Compare rubber yield, total material utilization and application-test evidence.
pitfalls: 以固定通用比例結算不同批次可能錯估產率。
刀具鈍化可增加耗能而未提高解離。
只量磁性出口總重會把附膠當鋼材回收。
以新料量選設備會忽略再磨造成的額外負荷。
只比較磨機用電會漏算冷卻製備成本。
把纖維當成同直徑球會錯估阻力和分選邊界。
平均尺寸相同的兩批仍可能有完全不同的細粉量。
只檢查表面會漏掉料堆內分層的鋼絲。
只報濾材效率會隱藏罩口漏捕。
把副產鋼加到膠粉收率分子會混淆產品基準。
pitfallsEn: A universal fixed composition can misstate yield across batches.
Dull cutters can increase energy without better liberation.
Total magnetic-product mass counts attached rubber as recovered steel.
Sizing equipment from fresh feed ignores recirculating load.
Mill electricity alone excludes cooling-supply costs.
Treating fiber as an equal-diameter sphere misestimates drag and separation.
Two batches with equal mean size may have very different fines.
Surface inspection misses steel segregated within the pile.
Filter efficiency alone hides hood-capture losses.
Adding steel coproduct to rubber yield mixes product bases.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
